subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Configure how subtitles are cleaned, and timed to prevent overlaps and remove unwanted formatting.
subtitle.ignoreCaptions: Skip translation if subtitles with caption tags exist:
subtitle.ignoreCaptionsDescription: Skip translation if a target subtitle with captions such as Hearing Impaired or Forced already exists.
subtitle.fixOverlappingDescription: Automatically resolves overlapping subtitles by trimming the end time of the earlier subtitle. This won't work on subtitles that are out of sync. And in most cases it also caused subtitles to go out of sync.
subtitle.stripFormattingDescription: Enable this option to remove all formatting tags (e.g., italics, bold, color, position) from (SRT) subtitles, resulting in plain text subtitles.
subtitle.preserveLineBreaksDescription: Keep multi-line subtitles split across lines after translation instead of merging them into a single line. AI services translate the whole subtitle in one call; classic services (DeepL, Google, Libre, etc.) translate each line separately.
subtitle.bilingualOutputDescription: Write the translated lines on top and the original line below in the same subtitle cue. ASS/SSA outputs render the original in a smaller font. Only affects new translations; existing ones can be converted from the translations page.
subtitle.addTranslatorInfoDescription: Add translator info at the beginning of subtitles.
subtitle.removeLanguageTagDescription: Remove language tags (e.g., ".en.") from file names.
subtitle.useTaggingDescription: Appends a custom segment to the subtitle filename however. This is not a recognised subtitle standard and may cause issues with other apps.

validation.title: Subtitle Validation
validation.description: Configure validation rules for subtitles. These rules will be applied when processing subtitle files. If a validation fails, the translation will be canceled.
validation.minDuration: The minimum time duration in milliseconds that a subtitle must be displayed:
validation.maxDuration: The maximum time duration in seconds that a subtitle can be displayed:
validation.minLength: The minimum number of characters that a subtitle must contain:
validation.maxLength: The maximum number of characters that a subtitle can contain:
validation.maxSize: The maximum size of a subtitle file in bytes:

translation.title: Translation Request
translation.description: Modify translation request settings by changing retry options or batch size if available in the service.
translation.useBatchDescription: Process multiple subtitle lines together in batches to improve translation efficiency and context awareness. Note that single-line translations with context are still more reliable and of higher quality.
translation.batchSizeDescription: Amount of subtitle lines in a single batch.
translation.requestTimeoutDescription: Maximum time in minutes to wait for a single request to the translation service. Increase this if you run a slow local AI on minimal hardware for example.
translation.maxRetriesDescription: Maximum number of retries per line or batch.
translation.retryDelayDescription: Initial delay before retrying, in seconds.
translation.retryDelayMultiplierDescription: Factor by which the delay increases after each retry.

translationPrompt.title: Translation Prompt
translationPrompt.description: Define the prompts used when translating subtitle lines.
translationPrompt.systemPromptDescription: Define the AI's behavior and tone by setting global instructions.
translationPrompt.userPromptDescription: Use the context placeholders to include lines before and after the current subtitle, helping the AI generate a more accurate translation.
translationPrompt.structuredContextDescription: Sends {'{'}contextBefore{'}'} and {'{'}contextAfter{'}'} as one JSON object per line with its position and text, plus the translation for lines that are already translated, so the AI can keep names and terms consistent. Only applies when the placeholders are used in the user prompt; tell the model in the prompt to follow the earlier translations.
translationPrompt.batchNote: The user prompt is not applied when sending subtitles in batch; the subtitle batch is sent directly as the user message.

proofread.title: Proofread Prompt
proofread.description: Define the prompts used when proofreading an already completed translation.
proofread.systemPromptDescription: Define the AI's behavior when comparing a translated line against its source line.
proofread.userPromptDescription: Sent together with the source line and its existing translation for each proofread request.
